params.name: median_ksize
params.help: Median filter size in px before motion correction (<= 1 skips it).

params.name: tophat_wnd
params.help: Tophat window in px that removes the background glow; about one cell diameter.

params.name: motion_max_shift
params.help: Largest motion correction shift in px.

params.name: motion_down
params.help: Downsampling factor of the frames used to estimate motion.

params.name: template_frames
params.help: Frames averaged into the motion template.

params.name: motion_before_tophat
params.help: Estimate motion before the tophat, on band-passed frames.

params.name: motion_bandpass
params.help: Difference-of-Gaussians sigmas (px) of the band-pass for motion.

params.name: template_source
params.help: Motion template from frames spread over the session ('spread') or from the first frames ('first', before Nov 2026).

params.name: template_chunks
params.help: Runs of frames spread over the session for a 'spread' template.

params.name: motion_fill
params.help: What motion correction puts where a shifted frame has no data: the template frames' mean ('template') or 0 ('zero', before Nov 2026).

params.name: motion_outlier
params.help: Replace a shift this many px off its neighbours when the frame matches the template badly (0 = off).

params.name: tile
params.help: Tile side in px for the low-rank compression.

params.name: svd_k0
params.help: Starting rank of each tile's randomized SVD.

params.name: svd_power_iter
params.help: Power iterations of the randomized SVD.

params.name: rank_rho_min
params.help: Smallest correlation a component needs to be kept.

params.name: rank_z
params.help: z-score a component's energy needs over noise to be kept.

params.name: noise_frames
params.help: Frames used for the per-pixel noise (0 = all); faster, but changes the units.

params.name: seeds_wnd
params.help: Frames per window when picking seed pixels.

params.name: seeds_stp
params.help: Step in frames between seed windows.

params.name: seeds_max_wnd
params.help: Window in px of the local-maximum search for seeds.

params.name: seeds_diff_thres
params.help: Smallest brightness difference that makes a local maximum a seed.

params.name: noise_freq
params.help: Frequency (fraction of the frame rate) above which a trace counts as noise.

params.name: pnr_thres
params.help: Peak-to-noise threshold for seeds; 'auto' picks it from the data.

params.name: gmm_refine
params.help: Also filter seeds with a 2-component Gaussian mixture (off by default).

params.name: merge_dist
params.help: Seeds closer than this (px) can merge.

params.name: merge_corr
params.help: Seeds whose traces correlate above this merge.

params.name: inita_corr
params.help: Correlation a pixel needs with its seed to join the initial footprint.

params.name: inita_wnd
params.help: Window in px around a seed for its initial footprint.

params.name: init_merge_corr
params.help: Initial units whose traces correlate above this merge.

params.name: loop_merge_corr
params.help: Units whose traces correlate above this merge during CNMF.

params.name: merge_min_dist
params.help: Units closer than this (px) merge whatever their traces do; 0 = off.

params.name: dl_wnd
params.help: Dilation window in px that bounds where a footprint may grow.

params.name: sparse_snr
params.help: Per-pixel signal-to-noise a pixel needs to stay in a footprint.

params.name: size_thres
params.help: Smallest and largest footprint size in px (empty = no limit).

params.name: n_iter
params.help: CNMF iterations (spatial + temporal update).

params.name: background_clip
params.help: Background of the clipped residual as Minian (about 2x slower).

params.name: workers
params.help: Worker processes; about the number of CPU cores minus one or two.

params.name: sub_batch
params.help: Frames per pass-1 sub-batch.
